ElementDescription: During the past week - How much of an effort do you make to resist these THOUGHTS? How often do you try to disregard them or turn your attention away from these thoughts as they enter your mind?
Notes: 0 = Make an effort to always resist, or symptoms so minimal that don't need to actively resist; 1 = Try to resist most of time; 2 = Make some effort to resist; 3 = Give in to all such thoughts without attempting to control them but give in with some reluctance; 4 = Completely and willingly give in to all such thoughts

ElementDescription: During the past week - How much control do you have over your THOUGHTS about your appearance concern(s)? How successful are you in stopping or diverting these thoughts?
Notes: 0 = Complete control, or no need for control because thoughts are so minimal; 1 = Much control, usually able to stop or divert these thoughts with some effort and concentration; 2 = Moderate control, sometimes able to stop or divert these thoughts; 3 = Little control, rarely successful in stopping thoughts, can only divert attention with difficulty; 4 = No control, experienced as completely involuntary, rarely able to even momentarily divert attention

ElementDescription: During the past week - How much time do you spend in ACTIVITIES related to your appearance concerns?

ElementDescription: During the past week - How would you feel if you were prevented from performing these ACTIVITIES? How anxious would you become?
Notes: 0 = None; 1 = Mild, only slightly anxious if activity prevented; 2 = Moderate, anxiety would mount but remain manageable if activity is prevented; 3 = Severe, prominent and very disturbing increase in anxiety if activity is interrupted; 4 = Extreme, incapacitating anxiety from any intervention aimed at modifying activity

ElementDescription: During the past week - How much of an effort do you make to resist these ACTIVITIES?
Notes: 0 = Make an effort to always resist, or symptoms so minimal don't need to actively resist; 1 = Try to resist most of the time; 2 = Make some effort to resist; 3 = Give in to almost all of these behaviors without attempting to control them, but do so with some reluctance; 4 = Completely and willingly give in to all behaviors related to body defect

ElementDescription: During the past week - How strong is the drive to perform these behaviors? How much control do you have over them?
Notes: 0 = Complete control, or control is unnecessary because symptoms are mild; 1 = Much control, experience pressure to perform the behavior, but usually able to exercise voluntary control over it; 2 = Moderate control, strong pressure to perform behavior, can control it only with difficulty; 3 = Little control, very strong drive to perform behavior, must be carried to completion, can delay only with difficulty; 4 = No control, drive to perform behavior experienced as completely involuntary and overpowering, rarely able to even momentarily delay activity

ElementDescription: During the past week - Do you think your appearance concerns are reasonable or rational? Is it possible that your appearance concerns might be less noticeable or less unattractive than you think it is? How convinced are you that your appearance is as unattractive as you think it is? Can anyone convince you that it doesn't look so bad?
Notes: 0 = I think my appearance concerns and behaviors are unreasonable or excessive; 1 = I think my appearance concerns and behaviors are unreasonable or excessive, but I'm not completely convinced that there isn't something about my appearance to be concerned about; 2 = I think my appearance concerns and behaviors may be unreasonable or excessive; 3 = I don't think my appearance concerns and behaviors are unreasonable or excessive; 4 = I am sure my appearance concerns and behaviors are reasonable, no matter what anyone says

ElementDescription: During the past week - Have you been avoiding doing anything, going any place, or being with anyone because of your thoughts or behaviors related to your appearance concerns?
Notes: 0 = No deliberate avoidance; 1 = Mild, minimal avoidance; 2 = Moderate, some avoidance clearly present; 3 = Severe, much avoidance; avoidance prominent; 4 = Extreme, very extensive avoidance; avoids almost all activities
